maddeler.e:
يفتخر (form VIII)
# يَفْتَخِرُ (yaftaḵiru) /jaf.ta.xi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَخَرَ (iftaḵara)
# يَفْتَخِرَ (yaftaḵira) /jaf.ta.xi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَخَرَ (iftaḵara)
# يَفْتَخِرْ (yaftaḵir) /jaf.ta.xir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِفْتَخَرَ (iftaḵara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
